As for being a beginner's rifle that depends on the overall wear of the firearm. An older bolt rifle can be an excellent first time piece. Some factors that go into consideration is the wear of the barrel, if the rifling is shot out then accuracy will be terrible. Next would be the bolt group, if there is a lot of slop in the action again accuracy and reliability will suffer. Aside from the condition of your firearm bolt actions tend too be highly accurate and fun to shoot. They see less ammo feed issues and are generally easier to clean and maintain. Aside from a failure to lock into battery the chances of a catastrophic failure is relatively low. I would suggest having a smithy eyeball it for any major issues then stock up on 8mm ammo.
